01 — About

Who I am

I'm a Master's student in Internet of Things at EURECOM, Sophia Antipolis, with a deep passion for digital transformation — the process of reimagining how technology reshapes industries and everyday life.

My work sits at the intersection of AI, Machine Learning and Deep Learning and the physical world. I design systems that sense their environment, reason about it with neural networks, and act upon it through embedded hardware and wireless networks.

From training CNN ensembles on medical imaging datasets to programming autonomous robots in C on ARM processors, I work across the full stack of intelligent connected systems.

03 — Projects

Selected work

01

Chest X-Ray Detection

CNN ensemble (VGG16/19 + ResNet50 + DenseNet) trained on 112,120 NIH images across 14 pathologies. Occlusion sensitivity heatmaps for explainable AI. AUC 0.9801 · Sensitivity 96.63%.

Python · PyTorch · Deep Learning · Medical AI
02

Agentic AI Platforms

Research paper surveying multi-agent protocols for autonomous IoT ecosystems — vehicles, charging stations, traffic systems. Introduces a 6-layer analysis framework. Supervised by Prof. Jérôme Härri.

A2A · MCP · GITER · OpenSlice · Research
03

E.T. Robot

Autonomous EV3 mineral-collection robot with an 8-state Finite State Machine and real-time 2D odometry from wheel encoders and gyroscope. Cross-compiled C for ARM on ev3dev Linux.

C · LEGO EV3 · FSM · Embedded Systems
04

ParkGo — Smart Parking

Real-time IoT parking occupancy monitoring system for smart cities. Arduino sensors, MQTT broker, live web dashboard, and data-driven analytics for urban mobility.

Arduino · MQTT · IoT · Web Dashboard
